# netbox_available_vlan (Resource)

Per [the docs](https://netbox.readthedocs.io/en/stable/models/ipam/vlan/):

> A VLAN represents an isolated Layer 2 domain identified by a numeric ID (1–4094). VLANs may be assigned to specific sites or marked as global.
> Optionally, they can be organized within VLAN groups to define scope and enforce uniqueness.
>
> Each VLAN can also be assigned an operational status and a functional role. Statuses are hard-coded in NetBox and include the following:
> * Active
> * Reserved
> * Deprecated

This resource will retrieve the next available VLAN ID from a given VLAN group (specified by ID).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_site" "testSite" {
  name = "test site"
  slug = "test-site"
}

resource "netbox_vlan_group" "testGroup" {
  name        = "Group One"
  slug        = "group-one"
  scope_id    = netbox_site.testSite.id
  scope_type  = "dcim.site"
  description = "First VLAN group"
  vid_ranges  = [[1, 20]]
}

resource "netbox_available_vlan" "testVlan" {
  name        = "test-vlan"
  status      = "active"
  description = "Virtual network for testing purposes"
  group_id    = netbox_vlan_group.testGroup.id
  site_id     = netbox_vlan_group.testGroup.scope_id
}

resource "netbox_prefix" "testPrefix" {
  prefix      = "192.168.40.0/24"
  status      = "active"
  description = "test prefix"
  site_id     = netbox_site.testSite.id
  vlan_id     = netbox_available_vlan.testVlan.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the available vlan.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the available vlan.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the available vlan.
- `group_id` (Number) The ID of the group associated with the available vlan.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the available vlan. Needs NetBox 4.5.0 or later.
- `qinq_role` (String) One of [svlan, cvlan].
- `qinq_svlan` (Number) The qinq svlan of the available vlan.
- `role_id` (Number) The ID of the role associated with the available vlan.
- `site_id` (Number) The ID of the site associated with the available vlan.
- `status` (String) The status of the available vlan.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `tenant_id` (Number) The ID of the tenant associated with the available vlan.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.
- `vid` (Number) The VLAN ID (1-4094).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_available_vlan.example 1
```
